compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-7: Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic.

## Implementation
Create plugins/dso/skills/sprint/tests/test-migration-pair-order.sh (the ticket's pre-registered verify_commands target path; create the tests/ dir if needed) — a BEHAVIORAL suite driving the (not-yet-existent) helper plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/apply-two-pass-ordering.sh with stubbed `dso ticket show` / `ticket link` fixtures (and a stubbed detector on PATH for the no-recompute case). Per-case via `--case <name>`:
- no-recompute: stub a migration-class detector / ast-grep on PATH; assert the helper NEVER invokes it (reads the persisted marker only) — dd-1.
- sweep: marker migration-class=sweep + an automated-sweep/manual-verification pair → assert helper wires `ticket link <manual-verification> <automated-sweep> depends_on`.
- db-rollback: marker migration-class=db + forward-migration/rollback-verification pair → assert rollback-verification depends_on the forward migration.
- flag: a feature-flag pair (flag-cutover/flag-cleanup) present → assert flag-cleanup depends_on flag-cutover (only when the pair exists).
- absent-marker: no MIGRATION_CLASS comment and no feature-flag pair → assert no edges written, exit 0.
- inconclusive: marker migration-class=inconclusive (no flag pair) → assert no edges written.
- idempotent: re-run with the depends_on edge already present → assert no duplicate edge.
Marker fixtures use the hyphenated key `migration-class` (NOT migration_class) per migration-class-marker.md. Use tests/lib/assert.sh (silent on success); gate on exit code. chmod +x. Register in the REPO-ROOT .test-index keyed on the helper source path plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/apply-two-pass-ordering.sh.
RED requirement: the suite must exist and FAIL (helper absent) before task-2 makes it pass.

## TDD Test Spec
Given stubbed ticket fixtures encoding the LAST MIGRATION_CLASS comment (hyphenated migration-class key) and a stubbed detector on PATH; When apply-two-pass-ordering.sh runs per --case (no-recompute | sweep | db-rollback | flag | absent-marker | inconclusive | idempotent); Then the suite asserts the helper never invokes the detector (no-recompute), wires the correct depends_on edge for each pair type, writes no edges + exits 0 for absent-marker/inconclusive, and writes no duplicate on idempotent re-run.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Test file exists at the exact pre-registered path and is executable
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/skills/sprint/tests/test-migration-pair-order.sh
- [ ] Suite handles all seven cases (incl flag)
  Verify: for c in no-recompute sweep db-rollback flag absent-marker inconclusive idempotent; do grep -q -- "$c" plugins/dso/skills/sprint/tests/test-migration-pair-order.sh || { echo "MISSING CASE: $c"; exit 1; }; done
- [ ] Suite is behavioral (invokes the helper, not a grep of its source)
  Verify: grep -q 'apply-two-pass-ordering.sh' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/tests/test-migration-pair-order.sh
- [ ] no-recompute case stubs a detector to assert it is never called
  Verify: grep -Eq 'ast-grep|migration-class-detect|sg ' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/tests/test-migration-pair-order.sh
- [ ] Suite registered in repo-root .test-index keyed on the helper source path
  Verify: grep -q 'plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/apply-two-pass-ordering.sh:.*test-migration-pair-order.sh' .test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
